trials.claim: One-time purchase includes ongoing lifetime access to tier features and monitor allowance
trials.claimQuote: Yes. Your one-time purchase includes ongoing access to the features and monitor allowance in your selected tier, including updates to those features.
trials.reasoning: The exhibits only show regular monthly/annual billing and a generic termination data-deletion clause, with no evidence about deal buyers' one-time lifetime terms either way.

exhibits.quote: Fees are billed in advance monthly or annually and are non-refundable except where required by law.
exhibits.argument: The terms describe recurring monthly or annual billing, not a one-time purchase with ongoing lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: On termination your workspace data is retained for 90 days and then deleted.
exhibits.argument: Access and stored data can be terminated and deleted after 90 days, contradicting guaranteed ongoing lifetime access.

trials.claim: Every tier includes unlimited team members and exports of tracked-ad artwork and copy
trials.claimQuote: Every tier includes unlimited team members, projects with scoped access, PDF reports, protected report links and exports of available tracked-ad artwork and copy.
trials.reasoning: Unlimited team members are confirmed, but no exhibit directly confirms exports of tracked-ad artwork and copy on every tier, and the cited limits do not directly contradict such exports.

exhibits.quote: resell or redistribute raw Service data outside your organization or your clients;
exhibits.argument: Raw service data cannot be freely redistributed outside the organization or clients, limiting unlimited exports.

exhibits.quote: I also like the fact that you can save the competitors' ads as long as you have them monitored.
exhibits.argument: Saved ads are only kept while the competitor remains monitored, so artwork and copy exports are not permanently retained.

exhibits.quote: Every plan gets automatic fetching, AI strategy reads, unlimited team members and all 15 languages, and Agency, Max and Ultra add full whitelabel.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms every plan includes unlimited team members as claimed.

exhibits.quote: Yes — every plan includes unlimited team members.
exhibits.argument: The vendor FAQ directly confirms unlimited team members on every plan.

trials.claim: One competitor on one ad platform uses one monitor with up to five locations
trials.claimQuote: One competitor on one ad platform uses one monitor, with up to five supported locations.
trials.reasoning: The exhibits confirm one competitor on one platform uses one monitor, but neither mentions the claimed allowance of up to five locations.

exhibits.quote: A monitor is one competitor on one channel — their Facebook page on Meta, their domain in the Google Ads Transparency Center, or their advertiser profile on TikTok or LinkedIn.
exhibits.argument: The vendor defines one monitor as one competitor on one channel.

exhibits.quote: one competitor on two platforms uses two slots, so it fills up fast
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the one-competitor-one-platform equals one-monitor counting rule in practice.

trials.claim: TikTok coverage is limited to EEA, Switzerland and UK
trials.claimQuote: TikTok is limited to the EEA, Switzerland and the UK.
trials.reasoning: General TikTok advertising and a review mentioning TikTok tracking do not show where that tracking occurred, so they neither confirm nor contradict the EEA, Switzerland and UK limitation.

exhibits.quote: Track competitor ads across Meta Meta, Google Ads Google, TikTok TikTok & LinkedIn LinkedIn with real creatives, exact copy, weekly diffs and an AI strategy read.
exhibits.argument: The vendor advertises TikTok tracking generally with no EEA, Switzerland and UK limitation stated.

exhibits.quote: With Rival Ads I add my competitors once, and it tracks Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn on its own.
exhibits.argument: A buyer in Brazil reports tracking TikTok alongside other platforms, contradicting TikTok coverage limited to EEA, Switzerland and UK.

trials.claim: Growth tier fetches ads every seven days with monthly AI strategy reads
trials.claimQuote: Growth fetches ads every seven days and receives monthly AI strategy reads
trials.reasoning: The vendor states Growth fetches every 7 days and that Starter and Growth are guaranteed monthly AI strategy reads, with no contrary exhibit.

exhibits.quote: Starter and Growth fetch every 7 days; Scale, Agency and Max fetch every 3 days.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms Growth fetches every 7 days.

exhibits.quote: Starter and Growth are guaranteed monthly; a start or stop found by a source check can bring the next read forward once 14 days have passed since the previous read.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms Starter and Growth receive guaranteed monthly AI strategy reads.

trials.claim: Scale, Agency, Max and Ultra fetch every three days with weekly reads
trials.claimQuote: Scale, Agency, Max and Ultra fetch every three days and receive weekly reads.
trials.reasoning: The vendor's fetching and weekly-read lists include Scale, Agency and Max but omit Ultra, materially limiting the claim that Ultra also receives every-3-days fetching and weekly reads.

exhibits.quote: Starter and Growth fetch every 7 days; Scale, Agency and Max fetch every 3 days.
exhibits.argument: The official freshness statement omits Ultra from every-3-days fetching, undermining the claim that Ultra is included.

exhibits.quote: since the previous read. Scale, Agency and Max are guaranteed weekly.
exhibits.argument: The official AI-read guarantee lists only Scale, Agency and Max as weekly, omitting Ultra from the claimed weekly reads.

exhibits.quote: Starter and Growth fetch every 7 days; Scale, Agency and Max fetch every 3 days.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms Scale, Agency and Max fetch every 3 days.

exhibits.quote: Starter and Growth are guaranteed monthly; a start or stop found by a source check can bring the next read forward once 14 days have passed since the previous read. Scale, Agency and Max are guaranteed weekly.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms Scale, Agency and Max receive guaranteed weekly AI reads.
